description: This file serves as the entry point for the production build in a Qwik-based application, specifically for Vite's preview command. It imports necessary modules, including the QwikCity middleware, the Qwik city plan, and server-side rendering logic, and exports a configured QwikCity instance used for serving the application.

methods.name: createQwikCity
methods.description: Creates a QwikCity server handler with the specified configuration, including the render function and the Qwik city plan.
